data.reason_zh: LLM编辑跨模型优化计划，编译与GPU评分反馈驱动后续提案，MCTS累积奖励指导探索，属持续反馈的工程自改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals
scope_support.object_quote: We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment.
scope_support.persistence_quote: Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration
